capabilities: Add margin comments and replies anchored to selected text
Suggest edits that show as underlined insertions and strikethrough deletions with accept/reject cards
Format comment text and customize highlight colors, schemes, and annotation styles
Filter and view comments in a sidebar, status bar card views, and PDF export
Work across desktop, iPad, and phone layouts
disambiguation: Not a Notion app integration; the name only describes the comment style, and all data is stored locally in the vault.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The repository includes an agent skill and validation script for the comment format. The plugin uses no network, telemetry, or accounts.
intentEvidence: This is a fork of Document Comments by Kyle McDonald (@kylemcd).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to add inline margin comments or tracked suggestions to notes.

relations.evidence: This is a fork of Document Comments by Kyle McDonald (@kylemcd).
Pair this fork with Notion Selection Toolbar, another plugin of mine.
The optional Commander plugin can add commands to the editor menu.
Use BRAT to install a pre-release build

summary: Margin comment system that stores comment threads as HTML comments inside the Markdown file, with suggesting mode, custom highlight colors, and PDF export of comments.
